text.p: West Indies batsman Brian Lara is being asked by English county Warwickshire to consider a return as their overseas player for 1998.
Warwickshire's chief executive Dennis Amiss confirmed that tentative inquiries had been made but added: "We certainly wouldn't want Brian back unless he was hungry to play county cricket again."
Lara helped Warwickshire to a record-breaking treble of English domestic trophies in 1994 but pulled out of a contract for this year, complaining of `burn-out'.
The county replaced him with South African all-rounder Shaun Pollock and for 1997 welcome back Pollock's compatriot Allan Donald for probably his last season in English county cricket.
